fields.System.Title: OUT-601 — Create a shipment
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a shipping clerk, I want to open a shipment for a carrier and vehicle, so that
cartons have something to be loaded onto.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a carrier and vehicle reference, when I create a shipment, then it is created
  • in loading status.
  • - Given the shipment, then it records the carrier, vehicle, driver, dock, and planned
  • departure.
  • - Given an unknown carrier, then creation is rejected.
  • - Given an open shipment for the same carrier and vehicle, then I am warned before
  • creating a second.
